title: Pork Biryani with Vibrant Filipino Flair
description: A fusion of Filipino and Indian flavors, this pork biryani is a flavorful and aromatic dish that combines the spices of the East with the freshness of the Philippines.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Add onions and cook until browned.
Add garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add pork and cook until browned. Remove from heat and set aside.
In a large pot, heat oil over medium heat. Add turmeric, coriander powder, cumin powder, and red pepper flakes. Cook for 1 minute.
Add rice to the pot and cook for 2 minutes.
Add pork, onions, garlic, and ginger to the pot. Mix well.
Add coconut milk and 2 cups of water to the pot. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and cover the pot. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Turn off heat and let the biryani sit for 5 minutes.
Fluff the biryani with a fork and serve hot.
